picks.editorial_note: DOE's Genesis Mission selected a Fermilab-led team to build AI systems that control and optimize particle accelerator performance — a flagship national initiative applying AI directly to frontier physics infrastructure.
picks.title: DOE selects Fermilab-led AI initiative to advance particle accelerator performance

picks.editorial_note: A £5 million UK government-backed trial of AI-driven flight path adjustments to cut aviation contrails is a rare case of AI research moving straight into real-world climate policy and industry practice.
picks.title: Operation Blue Skies takes off: landmark trial to test AI-driven contrail avoidance

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's discovery of 'attribution decay' — that generative AI outputs often can't be traced to any specific training example — is a genuine scientific finding with major implications for AI copyright and provenance debates.
picks.title: When AI art has no author: MIT study finds generated images often can't be traced to any training data

picks.editorial_note: Purdue's role in over $42 million of NSF Integrated Data Systems and Services grants underscores a major federal investment in building the national AI- and data-driven cyberinfrastructure academic researchers depend on.
picks.title: Purdue enables AI- and data- cyberinfras...
picks.university: Purdue Rosen Center for Advanced Computing

picks.editorial_note: NCSA and UCLA's $9 million NSF-funded iDLab will unify browser-based access to national HPC centers, directly advancing the NAIRR/AI research-access agenda at national scale.
picks.title: NCSA Partners with UCLA for iDLab

picks.editorial_note: A University of Houston projection that AI and data centers could help drive a 32% rise in U.S. electricity demand by 2030 has direct bearing on national energy policy and the sustainability of AI's growth trajectory.
picks.title: University of Houston Report Predicts U.S. Electricity Demand Could Rise 32% by 2030 | University of Houston

picks.editorial_note: Johns Hopkins' partnership with Toyota Research Institute pairs AI with high-throughput automated experiments to accelerate battery materials discovery — a concrete industry-academia collaboration with real materials-science payoff.
picks.title: Johns Hopkins team partners with Toyota Research Institute to accelerate new battery discovery

picks.editorial_note: MIT Lincoln Laboratory's ARCADE agentic AI debriefing assistant is being integrated into U.S. Air Force Collaborative Combat Aircraft operations, marking a significant step of academic AI research into military deployment.
picks.title: Human–AI mission debrief enters the Air Force through ARCADE

picks.editorial_note: Imperial College London's five-year partnership with Smith+Nephew to accelerate surgical robotics translates academic computer-vision research into a dedicated industry innovation center with direct clinical impact.
picks.title: New centre from Imperial and Smith+Nephew will accelerate innovation in surgical robotics

picks.editorial_note: EPFL's STING framework shows AI agents can be manipulated into harmful behavior through multi-turn conversations rather than single malicious prompts, a scientific finding with immediate relevance to AI safety and governance.
picks.title: How attackers persuade AI agents to break the rules
